text: Janey has 3 more than twice the number of books that Sally has. So Sally has 3 less than twice the number of books that Janey has. Janey has 21 books. So Sally has 21 - 3 = 18 books. The answer is 18.
3 loaves of bread cost 3 x 2 = 6 dollars. 2 bagels cost 2 x 1 = 2 dollars. 6 - 2 is 4. The answer is 4.
Sam ran 3 miles on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. So 3 + 3 + 3 = 9 miles. On Tuesday and Thursday, he ran 5 miles each day. So 5 + 5 = 10 miles. 9 + 10 is 19. The answer is 19.
Maddison started with 5 boxes of 50 marbles each. So she had 5 x 50 = 250 marbles. Then she got 20 more marbles. So she has 250 + 20 = 270 marbles. The answer is 270.
The lot cost 1/4 of the total. So the house cost 3/4 of the total. 120,000 * 3/4 = 90,000. The answer is 90,000.
Carlton's team has 13 players. Zeke's team has 7 more players than Carlton's. So Zeke's team has 13 + 7 = 20 players. So in total, there are 13 + 20 = 33 players. The answer is 33.

Jessa is 20 years old. Joan is 5 years older than Jessa. So Joan is 20 + 5 = 25 years old. Mary is 2 years younger than Joan. So Mary is 25 - 2 = 23 years old. The sum of their ages is 20 + 25 + 23 = 68. The answer is 68.
Bill started on the 3rd floor. 4 times 3 is 12. 12 + 6 is 18. So Bill is now on the 18th floor. The answer is 18.
There are 1000 members. Each member posts an average of 3 posts per day. So 1000 x 3 = 3000 posts per day. In March, there are 31 days. So 3000 x 31 = 93000 posts. The answer is 93000.

Marty has 100 centimeters of ribbon. He must cut it into 4 equal parts. So each part will be 100 / 4 = 25 centimeters. Each of the 4 parts must be cut into 5 equal parts. So each final cut will be 25 / 5 = 5 centimeters. The answer is 5.

John manufactured 4 tables for 20 dollars each. That is 4 x 20 = 80 dollars. He also manufactured 2 roof frames for 10 dollars each. That is 2 x 10 = 20 dollars. So Ali has to pay John 80 + 20 = 100 dollars. The answer is 100.
The farmer has 900 eggs. Each tray holds 30 eggs. So he can make 900 / 30 = 30 trays. Each tray is $2.5. So he will earn 30 x 2.5 = 75 dollars. The answer is 75.
Last week, she bought 4 boxes of cereal. This week, she bought 3 + 5 = 8 boxes of cereal. So this week she bought 8 - 4 = 4 more boxes of cereal than last week. The answer is 4.
Each quarter is 12 minutes. So 4 quarters is 4 x 12 = 48 minutes. The game was extended for 5 more minutes. So the entire game lasted 48 + 5 = 53 minutes. The answer is 53.
Each window is 35 inches wide. There are 5 windows. So the total width is 5 x 35 = 175 inches. Luke needs to buy fabric equal to 2 times the total width. So 2 x 175 = 350 inches. The answer is 350.

For 1 muffin, Svetlana needs 5 tablespoons of flour, 3 tablespoons of sugar, and 0.25 of a tablespoon of salt. So for 16 muffins, she needs 16 * 5 = 80 tablespoons of flour, 16 * 3 = 48 tablespoons of sugar, and 16 * 0.25 = 4 tablespoons of salt. So in total, she needs 80 + 48 + 4 = 132 tablespoons of dry ingredients. The answer is 132.

Sofie has 25 more books than Anne. Anne has 12 fewer books than Fawn. So Fawn has 25 + 12 = 37 more books than Anne. Together, they have 85 books. So Anne has 85 - 37 = 48 books. Fawn has 48 + 12 = 60 books. The answer is 60.
The winner got 3/4 of the votes. So the loser got 1/4 of the votes. 80 students voted. 1/4 of 80 is 20. The answer is 20.

Brady has 100 pennies, 40 nickels, 20 dimes, and 40 pieces of dollar bills. 100 pennies is 1 dollar. 40 nickels is 2 dollars. 20 dimes is 2 dollars. 40 dollar bills is 40 dollars. So Brady has 1 + 2 + 2 + 40 = 45 dollars. The answer is 45.

There are 10 quarts of tea left. 4 students drank 1.5 quarts each. So 4 x 1.5 = 6 quarts were drank. 16 students drank 2 quarts each. So 16 x 2 = 32 quarts were drank. So in total, 6 + 32 = 38 quarts were drank. 38 quarts is 9.5 gallons. The answer is 9.5.

Each tomato plant yields 22 tomatoes. 5 tomato plants will yield 5 x 22 = 110 tomatoes. Each plant of eggplant yields 4 eggplants. 8 plants of eggplant will yield 8 x 4 = 32 eggplants. So in total, Ricardo will get 110 + 32 = 142 fruits. The answer is 142.
The mean is the average of the numbers. The sum of the numbers is 50 + 80 + 80 + 60 + 40 + 90 + 100 + 70 + 60 = 600. There are 9 numbers. So the mean is 600 / 9 = 66.67. The answer is 66.67.

3 baskets of green food will cost 3 x 25 = 75 dollars. 3 baskets of red food will cost 3 x 18 = 54 dollars. So in total, you will have to pay 75 + 54 = 129 dollars. You will get 2 dollars off for each basket of red food. So you will have to pay 129 - 2 x 3 = 123 dollars. The answer is 123.

One red car costs $4. So 5 red cars cost 5 x 4 = 20. One action figure costs $5. So 3 action figures cost 3 x 5 = 15. The doll cost as much as 3 action figures. So the doll cost 15. So the total cost is 20 + 15 + 15 = 50. The answer is 50.

Cole hid 3 dozen eggs. Lamar found 5 eggs. Stacy found twice as many as Lamar. So Stacy found 2 x 5 = 10 eggs. Charlie found 2 less than Stacy. So Charlie found 10 - 2 = 8 eggs. Mei found half as many as Charlie. So Mei found 8 / 2 = 4 eggs. So there are 3 dozen - 5 - 10 - 8 - 4 = 36 - 27 = 9 eggs still hidden. The answer is 9.

The shortest tree is 6 feet tall. The second tree is 5 feet more than the shortest tree. So it is 6 + 5 = 11 feet tall. The tallest tree is twice the height of the two trees combined. So it is 2 * (6 + 11) = 34 feet tall. The answer is 34.

4 buses can hold 4 x 60 = 240 employees. 6 minibusses can hold 6 x 30 = 180 employees. 10 minivans can hold 10 x 15 = 150 employees. So in total, 240 + 180 + 150 = 570 employees can join the day trip. The answer is 570.

The dance studio has 10 students. It costs $25 to rent the studio. It costs $1.50 per student per session. So 10 x 3 x 1.50 = 45 dollars. So the total earnings are 25 + 45 = 70 dollars. The answer is 70.

The first dog needs to walk 1 mile. The second dog needs to walk 4 miles. The third dog needs to walk 3 miles. So in total, they need to walk 1 + 4 + 3 = 8 miles. On average, they need to walk 3 miles per day. So the last dog needs to walk 8 - 3 = 5 miles. The answer is 5.
They have raised 2100 dollars after 3 hours. So in 1 hour, they raised 2100 / 3 = 700 dollars. So in total, they will have to fundraise 6300 / 700 = 9 hours. The answer is 9.

The first tuna weighs 56 kilograms. The second tuna weighs 46 kilograms. The third tuna weighs 26 kilograms. So in total, the 3 tunas weigh 56 + 46 + 26 = 128 kilograms. If a kilogram of tuna costs $0.50, then 128 x 0.50 = 64 dollars. The answer is 64.

Cindy had 5 green eggs. She had twice as many blue eggs as green eggs. So she had 2 * 5 = 10 blue eggs. She had one fewer pink eggs than blue eggs. So she had 10 - 1 = 9 pink eggs. She had one-third as many yellow eggs as pink eggs. So she had 1/3 * 9 = 3 yellow eggs. So she had 5 + 10 + 9 + 3 = 27 eggs. The answer is 27.

Winston picked 6 pounds of peaches for 2 dollars each. That is 6 x 2 = 12 dollars. He picked 8 pounds of plums for 1 dollar each. That is 8 x 1 = 8 dollars. He picked 6 pounds of apricots for 3 dollars each. That is 6 x 3 = 18 dollars. So he spent 12 + 8 + 18 = 38 dollars. The answer is 38.

The first side takes 5 minutes. The second and third sides each take twice that long. So 2 * 5 = 10 minutes. The last 2 sides each take half as long as the first. So 5 / 2 = 2.5 minutes. The last 2 sides take 2.5 + 2.5 = 5 minutes. So the total time is 5 + 5 + 10 + 5 = 25 minutes. The answer is 25.

100 guests were originally booked. 24 guests checked out early. 15 guests checked out late. So 24 + 15 = 39 guests checked out. 2 * 15 = 30 guests checked in. 30 + 7 = 37 guests checked in after dinner. So 39 + 37 = 76 guests are now at the hotel. The answer is 76.

There are 35 marshmallows. Each S'more uses one marshmallow. So 35 / 1 = 35 S'mores can be made. John makes 9 S'mores. DeSean makes 9 S'mores. So they make 9 + 9 = 18 S'mores. They dropped 3 marshmallows on the ground. So they have 35 - 18 - 3 = 14 marshmallows left. Each kid can have 14 / 2 = 7 S'mores. The answer is 7.

Team A scored 4 goals in the first half. Team B scored 2 goals fewer than team A. So team B scored 4 - 2 = 2 goals. In the second half, team A scored 1/4 of the number of goals scored by team B. So team A scored 1/4 * 2 = 1/2 goals. Team B scored 4 times the number of goals it scored in the first half. So team B scored 4 * 2 = 8 goals. The total number of goals scored in the match is 4 + 2 + 1/2 + 8 = 15. The answer is 15.

Mark bought 3 packs for 1800 each. So that is 3 x 1800 = 5400. He got 1 card worth 4000 and another worth 1000. So that is 4000 + 1000 = 5000. The other 30 cards are worth 50 each. So that is 30 x 50 = 1500. So in total, he got 5400 + 5000 + 1500 = 11900. The answer is 11900.

5 people on bicycles will be 5 x 2 = 10 dollars. 3 people on tricycles will be 3 x 3 = 9 dollars. 1 person on a unicycle will be 1 x 2 = 2 dollars. So in total she made 10 + 9 + 2 = 21 dollars. The answer is 21.
11 small shirts is 11 x 3 = 33 square feet. 8 medium shirts is 8 x 4 = 32 square feet. 6 large shirts is 6 x 6 = 36 square feet. So the total is 33 + 32 + 36 = 101 square feet. The answer is 101.

There were originally 30 cars. 5 cars took an exit. So 30 - 5 = 25 cars were left. 20 more cars drove through in the remaining 15 minutes. So 25 + 20 = 45 cars drove through the traffic jam in the first 15 minutes. The answer is 45.

Kate has 3 boxes of 64 crayons. So she has 3 x 64 = 192 crayons. She melted 8 crayons. So she has 192 - 8 = 184 crayons left. She can make 184 / 8 = 23 muffins. Each muffin is 1.50 dollars. So she can make 23 x 1.50 = 34.50 dollars. The answer is 34.50.
Julia had 12 spoons in total. She used 3 to sample her stew. So she had 12 - 3 = 9 spoons left. The answer is 9.

On Monday and Tuesday, he watched 2 hours of TV. On Wednesday, he watched some 30-minute episodes. On Thursday, he watched 1 hour and 30 minutes. On Friday, he watched 2 hours. So in total, he watched 2 + 2 + 30 + 1 + 30 + 2 = 69 minutes. 69 minutes is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour and 69 minutes divided by 60 is 1 hour

The low setting removes 1 liter per day. The medium setting removes twice as much as the low setting, so it removes 2 liters per day. The high setting removes twice as much as the medium setting, so it removes 4 liters per day. So in total, the dehumidifier removed 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 liters of water. The answer is 7.
